scenes.light: night, warm tram lamps, rain outside

beats.act: The last tram rattles through the rain. Mae walks down the empty aisle with the ticket punch in her hand.
Theo sits alone by the rear window, watching the dark water.

beats.say: Thirty-one years, and you are the only passenger I never charged. Tell me why you ride.
My father drove this line. He said the last stop is where the city lets go of you.
I never got to ride with him.

beats.act: Mae punches a ticket and presses it into his hand.
The tram turns the final corner. The harbour lights slide across the wet glass.
